_note: Supply pallets and the FOB's own stocks (feat/pallet-tagging, Captain 2026-10-15). Everything here is Proposed. A pallet holds STOCK UNITS of one or more stock kinds; its cash value is units x unit_value. Players tag pallets and captured vehicles in the field (sell, or gift to a faction); tagged lots are hauled home with the squad and offered at the debrief: sell now (quick price), keep in FOB storage, gift, or KEEP as the FOB's own stocks. See docs/pallets.md.
_ammo_pallets: Combined arms A8 (cg_brief queue item 2.6, docs/combined_arms.md 2.9.2), Proposed: an ammunition pallet per calibre (ammo_120mm, ammo_25mm, ammo_tow, smoke_salvos). In the field one is an item (item: data/items.json, too big for a man to carry: a truck's hold moves it, a helicopter sets it down) holding its load (load: [round item, count], the full pallet; what is left rides in the item's state). A vehicle within 8 m rearms from it at hand speed (VehicleLogistics). contents: its stock units if a tagged one is hauled home as a lot. They are not at enemy sites (sites lists none).
_sites: Pallets at enemy sites, in each module's own space (metres from its origin on the ground): kind, x, z. A site's vehicle is parked abandoned (the faction is hostile; nobody drives it) and can be tagged like a pallet.

stock_effects._note: A share of a cost one stock kind can cover, at offset_per_unit per unit. Stock is only used up for what it actually offsets.

draw._note: Draw from stocks into the armory stash: one unit of a stock kind becomes these items.

sale_mission._note: LATER (a hook only): convoy a lot to a fixer at a meeting point. Offer price ratio is above sell_stored_ratio; below betrayal_rep the fixer may rob the convoy.
